goals._track_note: Track A — Trust Foundation (G1-G5). Structural correctness of the DDD primitive/module/service layers.
goals.title: Primitives ship with scenarios
goals.calibration: 3-5 Go primitives in apps/stock-price/pkg/primitive/ (candidates: price-quote-normalizer, tier-fallback-selector, ohlcv-aggregator, price-staleness-classifier, exchange-code-router — dev-stock-price confirms exact set Phase 0). Each ≥3 scenarios (golden + edge + failure). Verify: CGO_ENABLED=0 go run ./cmd/sandbox -tier=primitive -scenario=all exits 0; ≥1 failure scenario; grep mattn/go-sqlite3 in pkg/primitive = 0 (R-CGO gate). Min 9 scenario files (3 prim × 3).

goals.title: Module composes primitives via ports
goals.calibration: ONE module: apps/stock-price/pkg/module/price_resolution/. Composes primitives via interface + an injected TierFetcher port (infra impl, never imported directly). Multi-primitive scenario = 3-tier fallback story. Fence-B + CGO: grep pkg/module/ imports (cross-module=0) + grep mattn/go-sqlite3|pkg/infrastructure in module = 0. history_aggregation module deferred post-pilot.

goals.title: Microservice has clean composition root
goals.calibration: cmd/server/main.go wires module + adapters; CGO SQLite fetcher injected HERE as TierFetcher infra impl. Zero domain logic in root. OpenAPI YAML in pkg/interface/http/. Port = 5000 internal / 5010 external (system-map.json, never hardcoded). grep FetchPrice|tierResult|normalize|aggregate in main.go = 0.

goals.title: Architecture fence enforced (offline depguard evidence)
goals.calibration: Go service → depguard via golangci-lint (SAME mechanism as TA+macro, NO SI-3/TS-fence dependency). apps/stock-price/.golangci.yml: Fence-A (pkg/primitive must not import application/infrastructure/interface OR mattn/go-sqlite3), Fence-B (pkg/module must not import infrastructure OR mattn/go-sqlite3), Fence-C (infra importable ONLY from cmd/server/main.go; exclusions !cmd/server/main.go, !*_test.go). CI job stock-price-go-lint working-directory=apps/stock-price OR offline proof. Pre-revert tag stock-price-pre-ci. AC-4a CI job, AC-4b deliberate Fence-A violation reproduces non-zero exit with 'Fence-A' + reverted + never committed (QA independent), AC-4c .golangci.yml freeze anchor most-recent commit on file at close.

goals.title: Red/green status is honest
goals.calibration: Honest-red contract. Test A = deliberate corruption of golden scenario (e.g. flip expected tier in tier-fallback-selector golden) → dashboard RED, diff captured. Test B = known golden → dashboard GREEN, diff=null. Both proven before YES. No false greens (QA runs known-bad scenarios). Pattern identical across all pilots.

goals.title: Dashboard is the trust contract (Path A user verbal OR Path B PO Playwright)
goals.calibration: Path B (PO Playwright headless) is Day-0 DEFAULT (L6). Path B command: Playwright + chromium-headless-shell against file://apps/stock-price/dashboard/index.html (TCC-staged via Terminal.app per L87). Acceptance: 0 console errors, 0 pageerrors, 0 requestfailed, all primitive+module+microservice cards rendered, NOT-RUN honestly displayed. Path A = user verbal YES on dashboard-only. Either path = YES, equal weight. VERDICT captured in docs/po-decisions/<date>-g9-stock-price-user-confirmation.md.

goals.calibration: Baseline from bug-inventory.json stock_price_baseline block (Phase 0 adds; fallback system-wide baselineCycleCount=1.5). max_cycles_allowed=2. Inject 1 deliberate SINGLE-literal bug into a stock-price primitive (e.g. wrong staleness threshold in price-staleness-classifier, or flipped comparison in tier-fallback-selector). Measure cycles to dashboard GREEN. Pre-revert tag stock-price-pre-inject.

goals.title: Regression alarm bell works
goals.calibration: 2-trial coupling-proof rubric (TA cycle-17 / macro cycle-57 precedent). Trial-1 = G10 primitive mutation + fix. Trial-2 = DIFFERENT primitive mutation + fix. Both must show ≥1 coupled scenario RED + single-edit fix repairs all coupled REDs. Outcome-(a) × 2 = PASS.
